control.description-key: Numbered markers, arrows, boxes, freehand and notes on a photo. Outputs the photo with marks burned in plus every mark as data.

property.name: ImageDataUri
property.description-key: JSON(Photo, JSONFormat.IncludeBinaryData), without the surrounding quotes.

property.name: AnnotationJson
property.description-key: fp_annotationjson of the photo, to keep editing earlier marks.

property.name: AnnotatedImageDataUri
property.description-key: The photo with marks burned in, full resolution, JPEG. Empty when there are no marks.

property.name: AnnotationJsonOut
property.description-key: Every mark as data: type, relative points, colour, number, text.
